plugins.name: clear-prep
plugins.description: Run /clear-prep before /clear to back up durable memory and in-progress session state; a bundled hook then auto-restores the handoff note right after.

plugins.name: codex-stream-review
plugins.description: Claude+Codex adversarial cross-review on a resumable Codex thread — multi-round follow-up via codex exec resume, no diff re-send after round 1.

plugins.name: visual-verify
plugins.description: Detects a web project's own dev tooling, starts/reuses its dev server, drives a real browser with Playwright to capture a screenshot of the target UI, then cleans up — stack-agnostic, no auth-bypass or mock-variant switching built in.
